subject: striped lighthouse
concept: A LEGO model of a chunky cylindrical lighthouse tower with a red-and-white striped body, a lantern room on top, and a small rocky base plate.
features: Tall round-brick tower with alternating red and white stripes
Glass-look lantern room at the top with a round tile light
Small rock/grass base plate with a tuft of studs for texture
Tiny round window details along the tower side
simplifications: Made the tower a straight stacked-brick cylinder instead of a tapering realistic shape, since tapering needs many angled parts
Replaced a rotating light beam with a single bright round tile/dome, since light beams can't be physically built
Removed sea, waves and cliffs, since flowing water can't be built and would add a second scene
Kept the base small and flat instead of jagged rocks, since thin jagged shapes are fragile
Fixed the model upright with no railing figures or ladders, since thin railings and tiny accessories are hard to build stably
